recipe_version.title: Roasted Cauliflower Shawarma Plate
recipe_version.description: Oven-roasted cauliflower with store-bought shawarma spice, tahini and lemon drizzle, diced cucumber, and warm pita.

recipe_version.heat: Oven 425 F. The sauce is not cooked.
recipe_version.doneness: Cauliflower is done when the edges are charred and a stem is tender, about 25 minutes at 425 F.

ingredients.name: cauliflower

steps.title: Roast the cauliflower
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 425 F. While it heats, toss the florets with the oil and the shawarma spice and spread them in one layer on a sheet pan. Roast 25 minutes in the hot oven, until the edges are charred and a stem is tender.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: Whisk the tahini with the juice of 1/2 lemon and the 3 tbsp water until it drizzles off the spoon. Do not add garlic. The remaining lemon half is not served.

steps.title: Warm the pita and plate
steps.body: Dice the cucumber. For the last 3 minutes of the roast, warm the pita wrapped in foil in the same oven. Serve the cauliflower, cucumber, sauce, and pita on a plate. Do not wrap it, do not put it in a bowl, and do not add feta, herbs, hummus, or tomato.
